context:
Goal: the mailaudit team restarts in cloud sessions.
Departs from: main runs sessions on the Mac only — this adds a cloud environment for every role.
Why yours: it changes your claude.ai account's environment settings, which the safety rules keep for you.
Unvetted: the past-ruling check timed out.
Network hosts to add (step 2): cdn.playwright.dev, playwright.download.prss.microsoft.com, *.blob.core.windows.net. The Worker host is only for live probes, and its network secret reaches it anyway.
Setup script for step 1: docs/plans/cloud-setup.sh on branch claude/cloud-feasibility-e01860 (PR #246). Its full text was on this card until 2026-11-08 18:15 CST; the copy came out after the card closed, because the repo export reads its pinned Playwright version as an email address.
holds: The restart in the cloud (the gameplan in draft PR #246) waits on this.
home: plan cloud-sessions, Restart in the cloud, step 1
steps: On claude.ai/code, on the new-session screen, select the first control under the message box, then Add environment, then Setup script, and paste the setup script from this card's text.
Network access: choose Custom, tick the default list, and add the hosts this card lists.
Environment variables: add TZ=America/Chicago, and CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL with the model you pick.
Save changes, start one session on shivinate7/mailaudit, and mark this done.
title: Set up the mailaudit cloud environment
